cells.gaps: No source found says a mobile ID, ID wallet or signed credential is in service; OTP login by ID number is not one.
cells.note: ANID's 2026 deck says OTP authentication on the ID number is fully deployed and used on the public services portal, and that ANID verifies identity for banks and public services (TGO-004, TGO-005). Biometric authentication is the next phase, and no wallet is named.
